page.subtitle_html: Participle Clauses Basics — B2 participle clauses with -ing, V3, and reduced relative or adverbial meanings.
page.subtitle_text: B2 participle clauses with -ing, V3, and reduced relative or adverbial meanings.

blocks.body: {"level":"B2","intro":"Participle Clauses Basics: Participle clauses basics показує, як скорочувати relative and adverbial clauses with -ing or V3 forms.","rules":[{"label":"-ing clauses","text":"Use -ing clauses when the subject performs the action.","example":"Walking home, I saw an old friend."},{"label":"V3 clauses","text":"Use past participle clauses for passive meanings.","example":"Written in a hurry, the note was unclear."},{"label":"Same subject","text":"Keep the subject relationship clear to avoid ambiguity.","example":"Having finished the task, she left."}]}

page.title: Participle Clauses
page.subtitle_html: Participle Clauses - C1 present, past, and perfect participle clauses for reason, sequence, background action, and reduced relatives.
page.subtitle_text: C1 present, past, and perfect participle clauses for reason, sequence, background action, and reduced relatives.

blocks.body: {"level":"C1","intro":"Participle Clauses: C1 anchors for reducing clauses and showing reason, sequence, passive meaning, or background action.","rules":[{"label":"Present participle","text":"Use -ing clauses when the subject performs the action or when giving background information.","example":"Having little time, she finished only the introduction."},{"label":"Past participle","text":"Use V3 clauses for passive meanings and reduced relative clauses.","example":"Written in a hurry, the report contained several errors."},{"label":"Perfect participle","text":"Use having + V3 for an action completed before the main action.","example":"Having reviewed the evidence, the committee changed its decision."}]}

page.title: Advanced Participle And Absolute Clauses
page.subtitle_html: Advanced Participle And Absolute Clauses - C2 reduced clauses for sequence, reason, concession, and circumstance.
page.subtitle_text: C2 reduced clauses for sequence, reason, concession, and circumstance.

blocks.body: {"level":"C2","intro":"Advanced participle and absolute clauses: compact anchors for reduced clauses that condense time, reason, concession, and circumstances.","rules":[{"label":"Perfect participle","text":"Use Having + V3 for an earlier completed action.","example":"Having finished the report, she sent it to the manager."},{"label":"Past participle clause","text":"Use V3 clauses where the noun is affected by the action.","example":"Written in clear language, the policy was easy to follow."},{"label":"Absolute clause","text":"Use noun + participle to add an independent circumstance.","example":"All conditions having been met, the contract became valid."}]}
